definitions.explanation: An ornamental chain, string of beads, or similar jewelry worn around the neck.

examples.japanese: ⟦{真珠|しんじゅ}→真珠：19873_shinju⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{首飾|くびかざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}った→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I gave her a pearl necklace as a gift.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{受|う}け{継|つ}いだ→受け継ぐ：06700_uketsugu⟧{首飾|くびかざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I treasure the necklace I inherited from my grandmother.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧{首飾|くびかざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a necklace that goes with this dress.

notes:
USAGE:
{首飾|くびかざ}り is the native Japanese word for necklace. While ⟦ネックレス→ネックレス：04539_nekkuresu⟧ (from English "necklace") is also widely used, {首飾|くびかざ}り has a more traditional or literary feel and is often used for formal jewelry and precious ornaments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{真珠|しんじゅ}→真珠：19873_shinju⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{首飾|くびかざ}り (pearl necklace)
- {金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{首飾|くびかざ}り (gold necklace)
- {首飾|くびかざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to put on a necklace)
- {首飾|くびかざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧ (to take off a necklace)

FORMS:
⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧ (neck) + ⟦{飾|かざ}り→飾り：02539_kazari⟧ (ornament, decoration). Similar compounds include ⟦{髪飾|かみかざ}り→髪飾り：28228_kamikazari⟧ (hair ornament) and {腕飾|うでかざ}り (bracelet).
